moworks.notes: Round button r44; three bars 44 px long, 5 px, round caps. Over 560 ms power2.inOut (0.5-1.06 s): middle bar scaleX and opacity 1 → 0 in the first 40 %; outer bars move from ±14 px to the centre in the first 50 %, then rotate 0 → ±45° in the second 50 %. Reverse 1.6-2.16 s. Cursor presses at 0.45 and 1.55 s. Recipe at UI size: bars ±7 px. Params: duration (0.56 s) · gap (14 px) · angle (45°) · ease (power2.inOut). The middle bar shrinks away in the first 40 %; the outer bars meet in the first half and turn ±45° in the second.
